en: Vintage sepia photograph of a wide street leading to a tall, ornate early‑20th‑century hotel or commercial building with Art Nouveau / eclectic façade. The central building has five or six stories, decorative gables along the roofline, and many windows. Old cars or carriages and a few pedestrians are seen on the cobbled street. On the ground floor, vertical shop signs and a central balcony sign bear Cyrillic text.
